name: Namco All-Stars: Pac-Man and Dig Dug
summary: This compilation has straight ports of both classic arcade games and enhanced modes with updated graphics and sounds. Each title is also available on separate releases made for the casual market. The launcher screen gives access to the games, where the player creates a profile that keeps track of high-scores and other game-specific statistics. The difficulty level, starting stage and enhanced or classic modes can be selected on the main menu of each game. The help button brings up a small window with basic gameplay instructions. The games can be controlled with joystick, keyboard keys or with mouse movements and buttons.
